items.name: tokens
items.title: Design Tokens
items.description: 3-layer tokens (primitives, semantic, component) as CSS custom properties

items.name: tokens-dark
items.title: Dark Theme Tokens
items.description: Dark mode overrides via [data-theme=dark] selector

items.name: foundation
items.title: Typography + Fluid Scaling
items.description: Font stack, fluid type scale, container system, focus styles

items.name: utilities
items.title: Brand Utilities
items.description: Brand gradients (gradient-brand custom properties, .text-gradient) and section background variants (.bg-*)

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Press and the label swaps with a short lift; six intents from primary to destructive. One primary action per section.

configurables.what: Visual intent of the button surface and text.
configurables.how: One primary per section. Use destructive-* only for irreversible actions. Default: primary.

configurables.what: Hit target and type scale of the control.
configurables.how: m for forms and content; s/xs for dense toolbars; l/xl for hero CTAs. Default: m.

configurables.what: Whether the label text-swap animation runs on hover/press.
configurables.how: false in dense tables or reduced-motion; true for marketing CTAs when motion is wanted. Default matches source: false.

configurables.what: Shows a busy state and blocks re-clicks while work is in flight.
configurables.how: true only during async submit; pair with disabled if the form must not resubmit.

configurables.what: Prevents interaction and dims the control.
configurables.how: true when prerequisites are unmet; prefer explaining why nearby, not only a dead button.

gotchas.note: Text-swap animation needs the real label as children string/node; do not replace children with a custom spinner while loading — use the loading prop.
Keep a clear accessible name; icon-only usage belongs on icon-button, not button with empty children.
Button CSS is global BEM (.btn*). Import the published stylesheet globally; CSS Modules will scope classes and break styles.

agent.usage:
import { Button } from '@/components/atoms/Button';

<Button variant="primary" size="m" animated>
  Save
</Button>

items.name: icon-button
items.title: IconButton
items.description: A square control that holds only an icon and rotates slightly on press. Toolbars, close, and dense actions.

configurables.what: Visual intent of the square icon control.
configurables.how: Match the surrounding button family. One primary per section; destructive only for irreversible actions. Default: primary.

configurables.what: Hit target of the icon-only control.
configurables.how: m for toolbars; s/xs for dense tables; l/xl for hero chrome. Default: m.

configurables.what: Prevents interaction and dims the control.
configurables.how: true when the action is unavailable; prefer a tooltip explaining why. Default: false.

configurables.what: Shows busy state and blocks re-clicks.
configurables.how: true only during async work; pair with disabled semantics for forms. Default: false.

configurables.what: Whether the icon rotation / motion runs on interaction.
configurables.how: true for marketing chrome; false in data-dense tables or reduced-motion contexts. Default: false.

gotchas.note: Always provide an accessible name (aria-label) — there is no visible text children.
Uses global BEM (.button*). Import published CSS globally; Modules will scope and break styles.

agent.usage:
import { IconButton } from '@/components/atoms/IconButton';

<IconButton variant="ghost" size="m" aria-label="Close" />

items.name: link-button
items.title: LinkButton
items.description: Inline text that shimmers as you hover, then navigates like a link. Secondary CTAs inside paragraphs or cards.

configurables.what: Type and padding scale of the inline link control.
configurables.how: default for body copy; sm/xs for dense meta; lg/xl for hero links. Default: default.

configurables.what: Prevents navigation and dims the link.
configurables.how: Prefer removing the link over a dead disabled style when possible. Default: false.

configurables.what: Whether the shimmer / text-swap motion runs on hover.
configurables.how: true for marketing CTAs in body; false in dense legal lists. Default: false.

gotchas.note: Requires a real href for keyboard and screen readers; do not fake links with onClick only.
children must be a string for animated text-swap paths.

agent.usage:
import { LinkButton } from '@/components/atoms/LinkButton';

<LinkButton href="/docs" size="default" animated>
  Read the docs
</LinkButton>

items.name: button-group
items.title: ButtonGroup
items.description: Buttons sit flush so related actions read as one control. Use for aligned toolbars, not free-floating CTAs.

configurables.what: Layout axis of grouped buttons.
configurables.how: horizontal for toolbars; vertical for stacked mobile actions. Default: horizontal.

gotchas.note: Children must be Button/IconButton siblings — spacing is owned by the group, not ad-hoc margins.

items.name: whatsapp-button
items.title: WhatsApp Button
items.description: Opens a WhatsApp chat — Atom’s contact path, never a form. Inline, pill, or icon with a sliding icon on hover.

gotchas.note: WhatsApp Button is CSS/registry oriented for marketing embeds; prefer LinkButton or Button patterns in app React when you need full TS props.
Link must open a real wa.me / api.whatsapp.com URL; never fake the chat with javascript:void.

agent.usage: Chat on WhatsApp

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A single-line field that shows focus, error, and disabled states as you type. Pair with field for label and helper.

configurables.what: Shows the error surface (border/color) on the field.
configurables.how: true only when validation failed and a helper/error message is visible nearby. Default: false.

gotchas.note: Pair with Field (label + helper/error) so the control has an accessible name and describedby.
iconLeft/iconRight are ReactNode slots — do not put interactive buttons inside without keyboard support.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line box that grows with longer answers. Bios, messages, and free-form notes.

gotchas.note: Pair with Field for label/helper/error; set rows thoughtfully for mobile keyboards.

agent.usage:
import { Textarea } from '@/components/atoms/Textarea';

<Textarea rows={4} placeholder="Notes" />

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Opens a searchable list; pick one option with keyboard or click. Groups long option sets cleanly.

gotchas.note: Controlled mode needs both value and onValueChange; open/onOpenChange for menu state.
Compose with SelectTrigger/SelectContent subcomponents — do not replace the trigger with a raw button.
Portal content may mismatch on first paint; prefer client-only mount for the open menu in Next.

agent.usage:
import { Select, SelectTrigger, SelectContent, SelectItem } from '@/components/atoms/Select';

<Select value={v} onValueChange={setV}>
  <SelectTrigger>Choose</SelectTrigger>
  <SelectContent>
    <SelectItem value="a">A</SelectItem>
  </SelectContent>
</Select>

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Ticks on or off; supports indeterminate when some children are selected. Multi-select lists and filters.

gotchas.note: Indeterminate is visual only — keep the accessible checked state in sync for AT.

agent.usage:
import { Checkbox } from '@/components/atoms/Checkbox';

<Checkbox checked={ok} onChange={setOk} label="I agree" />

items.name: radio
items.title: Radio
items.description: Picks exactly one option in a group; the previous choice clears. Mutually exclusive settings.

gotchas.note: Group radios with the same name and a fieldset/legend or Field group label.

agent.usage:
import { Radio, RadioGroup } from '@/components/atoms/Radio';

<RadioGroup value={v} onValueChange={setV}>
  <Radio value="a" label="A" />
  <Radio value="b" label="B" />
</RadioGroup>

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A switch that slides between on and off without a form submit. Instant preferences and feature flags.

configurables.what: On/off state of the switch.
configurables.how: Controlled: pass checked + onChange. Default uncontrolled depends on usage.

configurables.what: Prevents toggling.
configurables.how: true when the setting is locked by plan. Default: false.

configurables.what: Thumb motion on toggle.
configurables.how: true by default for preferences; false if reduced-motion is required at the call site. Default: false.

gotchas.note: Provide a visible label (label prop or Field) — a bare switch fails WCAG name.

agent.usage:
import { Toggle } from '@/components/atoms/Toggle';

<Toggle checked={on} onChange={setOn} label="Email alerts" />

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Wraps a control with label, helper, and error so the whole row stays aligned. Required around every form input.

configurables.what: Marks the field as required in the label UI.
configurables.how: true when the form blocks submit without this value; still validate in code. Default: false.

configurables.what: Disables label + child control affordances.
configurables.how: true when the field is locked by plan; prefer explaining why nearby. Default: false.

gotchas.note: Pass htmlFor matching the control id, or wrap a single control so the label associates; put error text in error prop for aria-describedby patterns.
Field does not render the input itself — children must be Input/Select/Textarea/etc.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Click a tab and the indicator slides under it while the panel swaps. Sectioned content without page jumps.

configurables.what: Axis of the tab list and arrow-key navigation.
configurables.how: horizontal for page sections; vertical for settings side-tabs. Default: horizontal.

gotchas.note: Uncontrolled: defaultValue. Controlled: value + onValueChange. Each TabsTrigger value must match a TabsContent value.
Arrow keys move selection along orientation; keep one selected tab and associate panels via matching value strings.

agent.usage:
import { Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent } from '@/components/atoms/Tabs';

<Tabs defaultValue="general" orientation="horizontal">
  <TabsList>
    <TabsTrigger value="general">General</TabsTrigger>
    <TabsTrigger value="billing">Billing</TabsTrigger>
  </TabsList>
  <TabsContent value="general">Profile settings</TabsContent>
  <TabsContent value="billing">Invoices</TabsContent>
</Tabs>

items.name: divider
items.title: Divider
items.description: A thin line that separates blocks horizontally or vertically. Visual rhythm between groups of content.

configurables.what: Axis of the rule.
configurables.how: horizontal between stacked blocks; vertical in toolbars/inline groups. Default: horizontal.

gotchas.note: Vertical sets role=separator and aria-orientation=vertical; horizontal is a plain hr.

agent.usage:
import { Divider } from '@/components/atoms/Divider';

<section>…</section>
<Divider orientation="horizontal" />
<section>…</section>

items.name: section-header
items.title: SectionHeader
items.description: Eyebrow, title, and subtitle set the reading measure for a section entrance. Start every major block here.

items.name: prose
items.title: Prose
items.description: Drop long copy in one container; headings, lists, quotes, code, and tables inherit DS type. Articles and legal pages.

items.name: toc
items.title: Table of Contents
items.description: A side rail that highlights the heading you are reading and shows depth. Long docs; links come from headings.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Shows a face, initials, or fallback icon at a fixed size. People in lists, comments, and headers.

configurables.what: Content strategy for the avatar face.
configurables.how: image-border for product UIs with photo; initials when photo missing; icon for bots. Default: image-border.

configurables.what: Outer shape of the avatar.
configurables.how: circle default for people; square for brands/workspaces. Default: circle.

configurables.what: Pixel scale of the avatar.
configurables.how: s in lists; m in headers; l for profile heroes; xs in dense tables. Default: s.

configurables.what: Shows the presence/status pip.
configurables.how: true only when presence is real-time and meaningful. Default: false.

configurables.what: Loading placeholder surface.
configurables.how: true while the image URL is resolving. Default: false.

gotchas.note: Provide alt for image type or aria-label for initials/icon so the person/entity is named.

agent.usage:
import { Avatar } from '@/components/atoms/Avatar';

<Avatar type="image-border" size="m" src="/u/a.jpg" alt="Ada Lovelace" status />

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A small status chip that sits on an edge or next to a label. Counts, inbox state, and quiet flags.

configurables.what: Surface style of the status chip.
configurables.how: neutral for quiet metadata; inbox for count/attention chips. Default: neutral.

configurables.what: Emphasis of the badge relative to surrounding UI.
configurables.how: enabled default; focused when the related control is active; subtle for de-emphasized counts.

gotchas.note: If the badge is a live count, expose the meaning in accessible text (e.g. aria-label on the parent control), not only the digit.
Badges are inline; do not stretch them as block-level status banners — use toast or alert patterns for that.

agent.usage:
import { Badge } from '@/components/atoms/Badge';

<Badge variant="inbox" state="enabled">
  3
</Badge>

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A spinning mark that says “still working” without blocking the page. Inline loads and button pending states.

configurables.what: Visual scale of the spinner mark.
configurables.how: m inside buttons and default UI; xs/s for dense tables; l for page-level loading. Default: m.

gotchas.note: Root already exposes role=status and aria-label=Loading; do not nest another live region around it.
Decorative only — pair with disabled buttons or skeleton content so users know what is loading.

agent.usage:
import { Spinner } from '@/components/atoms/Spinner';

<Spinner size="m" />

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Grey shapes shimmer where content will land. First paint placeholders for cards, text, and avatars.

configurables.what: Placeholder geometry.
configurables.how: default for blocks/cards; circle for avatars; text for line stacks. Default: default.

gotchas.note: Mark the loading region with aria-busy on the container; skeleton itself is decorative.
Size via className/width styles to match the real component footprint — avoid layout shift when content swaps in.

agent.usage: import { Skeleton } from '@/components/atoms/Skeleton';

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Dims the page and centers a modal you must dismiss. Confirmations and short focused tasks.

configurables.what: Controlled visibility of the modal dialog.
configurables.how: Omit for uncontrolled Trigger flow. Pass open + onOpenChange for forms opened from tables/rows.

gotchas.note: role=dialog aria-modal with Escape + overlay click to close; body scroll locks while mounted. Always include DialogTitle for accessible name.
showCloseButton lives on DialogContent (default true). Prefer Dialog for multi-field tasks; use AlertDialog for binary confirms.

agent.usage:
import {
  Dialog, DialogTrigger, DialogContent, DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle, DialogDescription, DialogBody, DialogFooter,
} from '@/components/atoms/Dialog';

<Dialog>
  <DialogTrigger><button type="button">Edit</button></DialogTrigger>
  <DialogContent>
    <DialogHeader>
      <DialogTitle>Edit profile</DialogTitle>
      <DialogDescription>Update your public name.</DialogDescription>
    </DialogHeader>
    <DialogBody>{/* fields */}</DialogBody>
    <DialogFooter><button type="button">Save</button></DialogFooter>
  </DialogContent>
</Dialog>

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Rows of data you can sort and select. Dense records, not marketing layouts.

gotchas.note: Compose Table > TableHeader/Body/Footer + TableRow + TableHead/Cell. selected lives on TableRow, not the root table.
Use TableHead for column headers and TableCaption for a summary; avoid layout tables.

agent.usage: import { Table, TableHeader, TableBody, TableRow, TableHead, TableCell, TableCaption, } from '@/components/atoms/Table'; Invoices Customer Amount Ada $120

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Click a row and its height opens while the icon flips; one-open or many. FAQs and progressive disclosure.

gotchas.note: defaultOpen lives on AccordionItem, not Accordion. Pass it per item: <AccordionItem title="…" defaultOpen>.
Trigger is a button with aria-expanded; do not nest interactive elements inside title.

agent.usage:
import { Accordion, AccordionItem } from @/components/atoms/Accordion;

<Accordion>
  <AccordionItem title="Shipping" defaultOpen>
    Ships in 2–3 days.
  </AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem title="Returns">
    30-day window.
  </AccordionItem>
</Accordion>

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: AlertDialog
items.description: A blocking prompt with a clear decision — continue or cancel, including destructive. Irreversible actions.

configurables.what: Controlled visibility of the alert dialog.
configurables.how: Omit for uncontrolled Trigger flow. Pass open + onOpenChange for destructive confirms driven by app state.

gotchas.note: Content uses role=alertdialog and locks body scroll; Escape cancels. Overlay does not click-dismiss (unlike Dialog) — require Cancel/Action.
Compose AlertDialogTrigger + AlertDialogContent with Header/Title/Description/Footer + Cancel/Action. Action variant destructive-primary for irreversible ops.

agent.usage:
import {
  AlertDialog, AlertDialogTrigger, AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle, AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogAction,
} from '@/components/atoms/AlertDialog';

<AlertDialog>
  <AlertDialogTrigger><button type="button">Delete</button></AlertDialogTrigger>
  <AlertDialogContent>
    <AlertDialogHeader>
      <AlertDialogTitle>Delete project?</AlertDialogTitle>
      <AlertDialogDescription>This cannot be undone.</AlertDialogDescription>
    </AlertDialogHeader>
    <AlertDialogFooter>
      <AlertDialogCancel />
      <AlertDialogAction variant="destructive-primary" onAction={() => {}} />
    </AlertDialogFooter>
  </AlertDialogContent>
</AlertDialog>

items.name: avatar-group
items.title: AvatarGroup
items.description: Faces stack with a +N overflow when the list grows. Team members and multi-assignee fields.

configurables.what: Size applied to all children avatars.
configurables.how: s in lists; m in page headers. Keep consistent with surrounding density. Default: s.

configurables.what: Shape applied to children.
configurables.how: Match Avatar shape in the same product surface. Default: circle.

configurables.what: Max faces before +N overflow.
configurables.how: 3–5 in cards; higher only when space is guaranteed.

gotchas.note: Children must be Avatar components; max trims visually and should be reflected in accessible summary text (+N people).

agent.usage:
import { Avatar, AvatarGroup } from '@/components/atoms/Avatar';

<AvatarGroup size="s" max={3}>
  <Avatar type="initials" initials="AL" alt="Ada" />
  <Avatar type="initials" initials="GR" alt="Grace" />
  <Avatar type="initials" initials="KT" alt="Katherine" />
  <Avatar type="initials" initials="XX" alt="Extra" />
</AvatarGroup>

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: A path of links that shows where you are and lets you jump up. Nested pages and deep product trees.

gotchas.note: Root is a nav with aria-label=Breadcrumb; mark the current page with BreadcrumbPage (aria-current=page), not a link.
Compose Breadcrumb > BreadcrumbItem + BreadcrumbSeparator; put BreadcrumbLink on ancestors and BreadcrumbPage on the leaf.

items.name: burger-icon
items.title: BurgerIcon
items.description: Three lines that morph into a close mark when the menu opens. Mobile nav toggles only.

webflow.exclude: anatomía y motion pertenecen a menu-button (statesWrittenAsClasses, sin CSS propio) — pegar el patrón menu-button, no el icono suelto

gotchas.note: BurgerIcon is presentational only — place it inside IconButton or menu-button for hit target and aria-expanded on the control, not on the icon spans.
The three lines are decorative; the parent control must expose the open/closed name (aria-label / aria-expanded).

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month grid to pick a date (or range) with keyboard support. Scheduling and date filters.

configurables.what: Selection model: one day or a from–to range.
configurables.how: single for pickers; range for booking/filters. Wire onSelect vs onRangeSelect accordingly. Default: single.

gotchas.note: Controlled via selected / rangeFrom+rangeTo. disabledDates is a predicate (date)=>boolean — not a list prop.
Month nav uses IconButtons; keep adjacent text labels for the field that owns the calendar.

agent.usage:
import { Calendar } from '@/components/atoms/Calendar';

<Calendar mode="single" selected={day} onSelect={setDay} />

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: A compact pill for a filter or selection you can remove. Multi-select tags and active filters.

configurables.what: Surface style of the chip (outlined vs filled).
configurables.how: outlined for filters at rest; filled when selected. Default: outlined.

configurables.what: Padding and type scale of the chip.
configurables.how: s for filter bars; m for forms; xs only in dense tables. Default: s.

configurables.what: Prevents remove/select interaction.
configurables.how: true when the filter is locked by plan or permissions. Default: false.

configurables.what: Error emphasis on the chip surface.
configurables.how: true only with an associated validation message. Default: false.

configurables.what: Forced focus ring for composed controls.
configurables.how: Prefer real :focus-visible; use focused only for composite widgets. Default: false.

configurables.what: Motion on appear/dismiss.
configurables.how: true for filter UIs; false in static meta lists. Default: false.

gotchas.note: onClose must have an accessible name (aria-label on the close control).
variant prop is named type (not variant) — keep in sync with registry variantProp.

agent.usage:
import { Chip } from '@/components/atoms/Chip';

<Chip type="filled" size="s" onClose={() => {}}>
  Design
</Chip>

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Type to filter options, then pick one like a select. Large catalogs where search beats scrolling.

configurables.what: Whether the first option is highlighted as the user types.
configurables.how: true for short lists (<20); false when accidental Enter would pick a wrong option.

gotchas.note: Compose Combobox + ComboboxInput + ComboboxContent/Item; controlled mode needs value/onValueChange and often open/onOpenChange.
Portal content can mismatch on first paint in Next — mount the open list on the client.
Pair with Field label; keep keyboard arrows/Enter/Escape working — do not replace the input with a non-textbox.

agent.usage:
import { Combobox, ComboboxInput, ComboboxContent, ComboboxItem } from '@/components/molecules/Combobox';

<Combobox value={v} onValueChange={setV}>
  <ComboboxInput placeholder="Search country" />
  <ComboboxContent>
    <ComboboxItem value="mx">Mexico</ComboboxItem>
    <ComboboxItem value="us">United States</ComboboxItem>
  </ComboboxContent>
</Combobox>

items.name: context-menu
items.title: ContextMenu
items.description: Right-click (or long-press) and a menu appears at the pointer. Row actions without cluttering the UI.

gotchas.note: Compose ContextMenu > ContextMenuTrigger + ContextMenuContent + ContextMenuItem. Right-click opens; Escape and outside click close.
Items use role=menuitem; keep labels short and prefer keyboard-accessible DropdownMenu for primary actions.
Content is position:fixed at cursor coords — ensure a stacking context and room near the viewport edge.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A panel slides in from the edge over the page. Filters, mobile nav, and secondary flows.

configurables.what: Controlled visibility of the drawer.
configurables.how: Omit for uncontrolled Trigger flow. Pass open + onOpenChange for mobile nav or filter panels from app state.

gotchas.note: direction (top|right|bottom|left, default bottom) is on DrawerContent, not the root. Drag handle dismisses past 100px threshold.
role=dialog aria-modal; Escape and overlay click close. Prefer bottom drawers on mobile, side drawers for desktop filters.
Locks body scroll while open; avoid nesting another scroll-lock modal without testing.

agent.usage:
import {
  Drawer, DrawerTrigger, DrawerContent, DrawerHeader,
  DrawerTitle, DrawerDescription, DrawerBody, DrawerFooter,
} from '@/components/atoms/Drawer';

<Drawer>
  <DrawerTrigger><button type="button">Filters</button></DrawerTrigger>
  <DrawerContent direction="bottom">
    <DrawerHeader>
      <DrawerTitle>Filters</DrawerTitle>
      <DrawerDescription>Narrow the list.</DrawerDescription>
    </DrawerHeader>
    <DrawerBody>{/* controls */}</DrawerBody>
    <DrawerFooter><button type="button">Apply</button></DrawerFooter>
  </DrawerContent>
</Drawer>

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: DropdownMenu
items.description: Click a trigger and a menu drops with actions or nested groups. App chrome and overflow menus.

configurables.what: Controlled open state of the menu.
configurables.how: Omit for uncontrolled (internal state). Pass open + onOpenChange when a parent must sync (toolbars, command palettes).

gotchas.note: Controlled: open + onOpenChange together. Content side/align live on DropdownMenuContent (bottom/start defaults), not on the root.
Trigger exposes aria-expanded and aria-haspopup=menu; keep menu items keyboard Enter/Space activatable.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: A calm blank state with icon, message, and optional CTA. Zero results and first-run screens.

configurables.what: Surface style of the empty state container.
configurables.how: default for page empties; outline inside cards; filled for soft callouts. Default: default.

gotchas.note: Compose EmptyHeader/Media/Title/Description/Content. Media has its own variant (default|icon).
Title should explain the empty state; put recovery actions in EmptyContent.

agent.usage:
import {
  Empty, EmptyHeader, EmptyMedia, EmptyTitle, EmptyDescription, EmptyContent,
} from '@/components/atoms/Empty';

<Empty variant="outline">
  <EmptyHeader>
    <EmptyMedia variant="icon">{/* icon */}</EmptyMedia>
    <EmptyTitle>No projects</EmptyTitle>
    <EmptyDescription>Create one to get started.</EmptyDescription>
  </EmptyHeader>
  <EmptyContent><button type="button">New project</button></EmptyContent>
</Empty>

items.name: icon
items.title: Icon
items.description: Sizes and colors an inline SVG; the DS owns scale, not the path art. Pair with any approved icon set.

items.name: logo
items.title: Logo
items.description: Official Atom mark that flips light/dark with data-theme. Never invent marks — use this asset only.

items.name: feature
items.title: Feature
items.description: Icon plus text (and optional value) in one row. Benefit lists, specs, and checklists.

items.name: image
items.title: Image
items.description: A responsive frame for media from thumb to hero. Product shots and section visuals.

configurables.what: Intrinsic display size of the image frame.
configurables.how: m for cards; l/hero for marketing; full for edge-to-edge bands. Default: m.

configurables.what: Aspect ratio lock for the frame before load.
configurables.how: 16x9 for video thumbs; 1x1 for avatars/product tiles; 21x9 only for cinematic heroes.

configurables.what: object-fit strategy inside the frame.
configurables.how: cover for crops/heroes; contain when the whole asset must stay visible (logos, diagrams).

configurables.what: Corner rounding of the image frame.
configurables.how: md for cards; full only for circular crops; none for full-bleed media.

gotchas.note: Always pass meaningful alt (or alt="" only when purely decorative and adjacent text already names it).
Forwards native img attributes; do not nest interactive buttons inside without a separate control pattern.

agent.usage:
import { Image } from '@/components/atoms/Image';

<Image
  src="/photos/hero.jpg"
  alt="Team workshop"
  size="l"
  ratio="16x9"
  fit="cover"
  radius="md"
/>

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: A single selectable row with optional leading/trailing slots. Lists, menus, and pickers.

configurables.what: Surface emphasis of the row.
configurables.how: default lists; outline for bordered menus; muted for secondary rows. Default: default.

configurables.what: Vertical density of the item.
configurables.how: default in main lists; sm/xs in sidebars and dense pickers. Default: default.

gotchas.note: With href, root renders <a>; otherwise <div>. Compose ItemMedia/Content/Title/Description/Actions; group with ItemGroup.
If clickable without href, add keyboard handlers and role; prefer href for navigation.

import {
  Item, ItemMedia, ItemContent, ItemTitle, ItemDescription, ItemActions,
} from '@/components/atoms/Item';

<Item variant="outline" size="default" href="/docs">
  <ItemMedia variant="icon">{/* icon */}</ItemMedia>
  <ItemContent>
    <ItemTitle>Docs</ItemTitle>
    <ItemDescription>Guides and API</ItemDescription>
  </ItemContent>
  <ItemActions>→</ItemActions>
</Item>

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: Content scrolls continuously along a track without interaction. Logo strips and social proof.

configurables.what: CSS-mode scroll speed used to derive animation duration from content width.
configurables.how: 75 for logo bars; 40–60 for dense text; 100–150 for punchy hero strips. Default: 75. Ignored when draggable.

configurables.what: Reverses travel direction.
configurables.how: true for opposing dual marquees. Default: false.

configurables.what: Pauses CSS animation while hovered.
configurables.how: true when items are links users must click. Default: false.

configurables.what: Edge fade masks on the track.
configurables.how: true for polished marketing; false when the track is full-bleed. Default: true.

configurables.what: Switches to GSAP draggable marquee contract instead of CSS loop.
configurables.how: true only when the animations package + data-draggable-marquee hooks are installed. Default: false.

configurables.what: Draggable-mode loop duration (data-duration).
configurables.how: 15–25 for logos; higher = slower. Source default is 20 when draggable. Only when draggable.

configurables.what: Draggable inertia multiplier (data-multiplier).
configurables.how: 30–40 default feel; lower for tighter control. Default: 35. Only when draggable.

configurables.what: Draggable drag sensitivity (data-sensitivity).
configurables.how: 0.01 default; raise slightly for touch-first UIs. Default: 0.01. Only when draggable.

gotchas.note: CSS mode duplicates children for seamless loop. Wrap each logo/line in MarqueeItem; use MarqueeSeparator between marks.
Duplicated list is aria-hidden; keep meaningful text in the first list only. Prefer pauseOnHover when content is interactive.
draggable requires the motion package hooks that read data-draggable-marquee attributes — without them the track will not move.

agent.usage:
import { Marquee, MarqueeItem, MarqueeSeparator } from '@/components/atoms/Marquee';

<Marquee speed={75} fade pauseOnHover>
  <MarqueeItem>Acme</MarqueeItem>
  <MarqueeSeparator />
  <MarqueeItem>Globex</MarqueeItem>
</Marquee>

items.name: nav-link
items.title: NavLink
items.description: A navigation link that shows active state as you move through the app. Sidebars and top nav.

configurables.what: Text and hit-target scale of the link.
configurables.how: default in main nav; sm in dense side lists; lg for marketing nav. Default: default.

configurables.what: Marks the link as the current page.
configurables.how: true only for the matching route (sets aria-current=page). Default: false.

configurables.what: Visually disables the link.
configurables.how: true for unavailable destinations; still provide href or omit navigation in the router layer. Default: false.

gotchas.note: children must be a string label; active sets aria-current=page — keep one active link per nav section.
Requires href + children. For SPA routers, wrap or pass the framework Link via className/href patterns your app uses.

agent.usage:
import { NavLink } from '@/components/atoms/NavLink';

<NavLink href="/docs" size="default" active>
  Docs
</NavLink>

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Pages of results with prev/next and numbered jumps. Large tables and search hits.

gotchas.note: Root nav has aria-label=Pagination; only one PaginationLink should set isActive (aria-current=page).
Compose Pagination > PaginationItem > PaginationLink|Previous|Next|Ellipsis. isActive/disabled live on link-level pieces, not the root nav.

items.name: progress-nav
items.title: ProgressNav
items.description: A stepped rail that fills as you advance through a flow. Wizards and multi-step forms.

gotchas.note: items is required [{id,label}]. Anchors must match section ids on the page. Motion hooks read data-progress-nav-* attributes.
Root is a nav; keep labels short. Logo links to topAnchor (default top); CTA is a plain href.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Drag a handle to grow or shrink adjacent panes. Split views and customizable workspaces.

webflow.exclude: paneles interactivos con estado (PanelGroup + drag) — sin equivalente estático útil en el Designer; consumir vía React

configurables.what: Split axis of the panel group.
configurables.how: horizontal for side-by-side editors; vertical for stacked panes. Default: horizontal.

configurables.what: How many panels share the track (initial equal %).
configurables.how: 2 for master-detail; 3 for IDE-like columns. Must match ResizablePanel count/indexes. Default: 2.

gotchas.note: Root API is ResizablePanelGroup + ResizablePanel + ResizableHandle. Panels need index 0..n-1; use outside group throws.
Min panel size is 10%. Give the group an explicit height/width or flex grow.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A surface rises from the bottom (or side) for a short task. Mobile-friendly alternatives to dialogs.

configurables.what: Controlled visibility of the sheet panel.
configurables.how: Omit for uncontrolled Trigger flow. Pass open + onOpenChange for filters/settings opened from app state.

gotchas.note: side (top|right|bottom|left, default right) and showCloseButton live on SheetContent, not the root.
Modal sheet locks body scroll; Escape and overlay close. Prefer Sheet for side panels; Dialog for centered tasks.

agent.usage:
import {
  Sheet, SheetTrigger, SheetContent, SheetHeader,
  SheetTitle, SheetDescription, SheetBody,
} from '@/components/atoms/Sheet';

<Sheet>
  <SheetTrigger><button type="button">Open</button></SheetTrigger>
  <SheetContent side="right">
    <SheetHeader>
      <SheetTitle>Settings</SheetTitle>
      <SheetDescription>Tune preferences.</SheetDescription>
    </SheetHeader>
    <SheetBody>{/* fields */}</SheetBody>
  </SheetContent>
</Sheet>

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Drag a thumb along a track to set a value. Ranges, volume, and continuous settings.

configurables.what: Lower bound of the range.
configurables.how: 0 for percentages; set to business min for money/quantity. Default: 0.

configurables.what: Upper bound of the range.
configurables.how: 100 for %; match the product ceiling. Must be > min. Default: 100.

configurables.what: Snap increment for keyboard and drag.
configurables.how: 1 for integers; 0.1/0.01 for fine controls. Default: 1.

configurables.what: Blocks interaction.
configurables.how: true when prerequisites are unmet. Default: false.

gotchas.note: Expose the value in text nearby or aria-valuetext; keep min/max/step consistent with the visible unit.
Controlled: value + onValueChange; uncontrolled: defaultValue. Values are numbers (or number[] if multi-thumb patterns are used).

agent.usage:
import { Slider } from '@/components/atoms/Slider';

<Slider min={0} max={100} step={5} value={volume} onValueChange={setVolume} />

items.name: stats-card
items.title: StatsCard
items.description: A metric with label and optional delta in a compact card. Dashboards and KPI strips.

configurables.what: Direction of the trend chip (with trendValue).
configurables.how: up for positive KPIs; down for regressions; neutral for flat. Omit both trend and trendValue when no delta.

configurables.what: Denser padding and type scale.
configurables.how: true in dense dashboards/tables; false for hero KPI strips.

configurables.what: Gradient surface treatment.
configurables.how: true sparingly for featured metrics; false for data-dense grids.

gotchas.note: value and label are required strings. Trend UI only renders when both trend and trendValue are set.
Trend icons are aria-hidden; put meaning in trendValue text (e.g. +12%).

agent.usage:
import { StatsCard } from '@/components/atoms/StatsCard';

<StatsCard value="12.4k" label="Active users" trend="up" trendValue="+8%" />

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Numbered steps show progress through a sequence. Checkouts and multi-stage onboarding.

gotchas.note: Stepper accepts orientation (horizontal|vertical) and steps: { state, title, description }[]. Keep exactly one step with state active.
Titles must be unique and human-readable; do not rely on color alone to convey completed vs upcoming.

items.name: tag
items.title: Tag
items.description: A small label for category or status — ghost, filled, or outlined. Metadata, not interactive filters.

configurables.what: Surface treatment of the status tag.
configurables.how: filled for primary status; outlined for quiet meta; ghost for inline. Default: filled.

configurables.what: Semantic color of the tag.
configurables.how: neutral for meta; success/warning/danger for state; brand/ai sparingly. Default: neutral.

configurables.what: Type and padding scale.
configurables.how: s default; xs for dense tables; m for marketing. Default: s.

configurables.what: Shows a leading status dot.
configurables.how: true for live/status lists; false for pure labels. Default: false.

gotchas.note: Tags are not interactive by default — do not use them as buttons; use Chip or Button.

agent.usage:
import { Tag } from '@/components/atoms/Tag';

<Tag variant="filled" intent="success" size="s">
  Live
</Tag>

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: A brief message slides in and dismisses itself. Success, error, warning, and info feedback.

webflow.exclude: runtime-only (portal imperativo, no produce HTML estático) — las notificaciones en Webflow van con el patrón del sitio, no con paste

gotchas.note: Mount <Toaster position="bottom-right" /> once at app root. Call toast()/toast.success|error|warning|info — not a declarative Toast tree.
Each toast is role=status aria-live=polite; default duration 4000ms (0 = sticky until dismiss).

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: ToggleGroup
items.description: Segmented options where one (or more) stay pressed. View switches and compact filters.

configurables.what: Selection model: one value or many.
configurables.how: single for segmented controls; multiple for multi-filter toolbars. Default: single.

configurables.what: Surface style of the group.
configurables.how: default for primary toolbars; outline on busy backgrounds. Default: default.

configurables.what: Hit target scale for items.
configurables.how: m default; xs/s for dense filters; l for marketing toggles. Default: m.

configurables.what: Layout axis of items.
configurables.how: horizontal almost always; vertical only in narrow side rails. Default: horizontal.

configurables.what: Motion on selection change.
configurables.how: true for marketing; false in data-dense admin. Default: false.

gotchas.note: Controlled mode needs value + onValueChange; type=single stores one string, multiple stores string[].
Each ToggleGroupItem needs a visible label or aria-label; group should sit in a labelled fieldset when used as a form control.

agent.usage:
import { ToggleGroup, ToggleGroupItem } from '@/components/atoms/ToggleGroup';

<ToggleGroup type="single" value={view} onValueChange={setView} size="m">
  <ToggleGroupItem value="list">List</ToggleGroupItem>
  <ToggleGroupItem value="grid">Grid</ToggleGroupItem>
</ToggleGroup>

items.name: typography
items.title: Typography
items.description: Display, title, body, and mono styles from the type scale. Any text that must match the DS.

webflow.exclude: las clases tipográficas viajan en foundation/embed CSS (/v1) y como estilos nativos del master — no es un paste de componente

gotchas.note: Import named levels (TypographyH1…TypographyP), not a single polymorphic Typography root — each maps to a semantic HTML heading/paragraph class.
Heading classes (.h1, .h2, …) are global BEM from the design system CSS — import the published stylesheet globally.

items.name: user-profile
items.title: UserProfile
items.description: Avatar plus name and optional meta in one block. Account headers and people cards.

gotchas.note: name is required. avatar spreads Avatar props; initials default from name words. org is optional subtitle.
Ensure Avatar gets a meaningful alt/aria via avatar props when using image type.

items.name: video-player
items.title: VideoPlayer
items.description: Play, pause, and scrub branded video with DS chrome. Product demos and embedded media.

configurables.what: Starts playback when the player activates.
configurables.how: false by default. true only with muted (autoplay policies); sets data-video-muted when autoplay is on.

configurables.what: Starts muted.
configurables.how: true for autoplay heroes; false when sound is intentional. Default: false.

gotchas.note: videoId is required (provider id). customer/placeholder optional. Behavior is driven by data-video-* attributes + motion/controller hooks.
Provide a real title/placeholder for the media region; do not autoplay with sound.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Collapsible app navigation with nested items and sections. Primary product shell chrome.

webflow.exclude: app chrome con estado (SidebarProvider/useSidebar) — no es objetivo de paste en sitios de marketing; consumir vía React

configurables.what: Which edge of the layout the sidebar docks to.
configurables.how: left for app chrome; right for inspector panels. Default: left.

gotchas.note: Must wrap with SidebarProvider (collapsed state). Compose SidebarHeader/Content/Footer + SidebarItem/Trigger; useSidebar() outside provider throws.
collapsed class is driven by provider state, not a Sidebar prop — toggle via SidebarTrigger or useSidebar().toggle.

    <SidebarFooter>v1</SidebarFooter>
  </Sidebar>
</SidebarProvider>

items.name: accordion-morph
items.title: Accordion Morph
items.description: FAQ accordion where each answer pours out of its question pill like liquid (SVG goo filter), settling into a clean rounded panel. Pair with the accordion-morph-animation hook.

items.question: Que hace diferentes a los marcos?
items.answer: Cada marco se lamina en carbono crudo en un molde propio y se termina a mano antes de encordar.

items.question: Fabrican para zurdos?
items.answer: Todo grip y balance se espeja bajo pedido sin costo extra.

items.question: Cual es la garantia por fisuras?
items.answer: Dos anos contra fallo estructural en juego normal, sin letra chica.

configurables.what: stdDeviation del blur goo — que tan espeso se ve el liquido al verter.
configurables.how: 9 es el balance firma; 4-6 para un vertido sutil en secciones densas; 12-16 solo en heros con una sola instancia (el blur alto cuesta GPU por fila).

configurables.what: Permite varias respuestas abiertas a la vez.
configurables.how: false para FAQs de marketing (foco en una respuesta); true solo en documentacion de referencia donde el lector compara respuestas.

configurables.what: Indice de la fila abierta al montar (-1 = ninguna).
configurables.how: 0 cuando la primera pregunta ES el mensaje (pricing, objecion principal); -1 en FAQs largas para no empujar el fold.

configurables.what: D5 canal codigo: false emite data-motion-exempt — disclosure instantaneo sin goo.
configurables.how: true salvo listas dentro de dashboards o tablas (el goo es protagonista, no acompanante); reduced-motion ya degrada solo, no uses false para eso.

gotchas.note: El componente NO anima solo: emparejar con initAccordionMorph() de @atom-uikit/animations (gsap + CustomEase + SplitText globales). Sin el behavior es un disclosure estatico cerrado.

Pildora y panel pintan su fondo con --card + --border y el texto usa --card-foreground + opacity: siguen al tema (blanco en light, oscuro en dark). El liquido va en --secondary. No sobreescribir esos fondos: son el rol crisp que tapa el wobble del filtro.
FUNCIONAL: reduced-motion y data-motion-exempt abren/cierran instantaneo via DOM directo — el disclosure jamas depende de gsap. aria-expanded/aria-hidden/inert los escribe el behavior.
El filtro SVG viaja como HtmlEmbed en el paste. El goo exige gsap+CustomEase en el footer del site; SplitText es opcional (sin el, la respuesta hace fade en vez de reveal por lineas).

<AccordionMorph items={[{ question: '...', answer: '...' }]} startOpen={0} />
// + una vez por pagina:
useEffect(() => initAccordionMorph(), []);
